WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORK

We are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. We are currently the top-ranked consulting firm on Glassdoor's Best Places to Work list and have earned the #1 overall spot a record seven times. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these don't happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join our Data Science & Machine Learning Engineering experts within the [1] Applied Technology & AI team. This team is part of Bain's digital capabilities practice, which includes experts in analytics, engineering, product management, and design. In this multidisciplinary environment, you'll leverage deep technical expertise with business acumen to help clients tackle their most transformative challenges. You'll work on integrated teams alongside our general consultants and clients to develop data-driven strategies and innovative solutions. Together, we create human-centric solutions that harness the power of data and artificial intelligence to drive competitive advantage for our clients. Our collaborative and supportive work environment fosters creativity and continuous learning, enabling us to consistently deliver exceptional results.

THE ROLE

As a Lead, Full-Stack Data Scientist, you will leverage your experience to design, implement and refine algorithms to extract and use actionable information from multi-modal data across a wide range of industries and business problems. You bring a strong generalist foundation across core data science methods (e.g., statistics, forecasting, optimization, and machine learning) that lets you move fluidly across problem types rather than specializing narrowly in one. You’ll develop and deploy analytical and machine learning models that power production systems such as dynamic personalization and pricing engines, predictive maintenance and always-on forecasting and optimization capabilities.

You will have opportunities to work with major AI ecosystem partners through Bain’s partnerships, collaborating on real client deployments and helping shape how emerging capabilities are applied in enterprise settings.

Bain offers significant learning and growth opportunities through the breadth and depth of problems we solve, the level of impact we help clients achieve, and our apprenticeship model. You will learn by doing, with support from experienced teammates, frequent feedback, and increasing responsibility over time.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Develop data, technology and AI solutions, leveraging a spectrum of techniques including data science, machine learning, AI algorithms to address large-scale enterprise challenges and enable production systems

• Develop and maintain long-lasting models, algorithms, and tools that support internal or client needs

• Collaborate closely with and influence general consulting teams to identify analytics solutions for client business problems and to execute those solutions

• Leverage AI tools with guardrails to accelerate and amplify design, development and implementation phases across the life cycle

• Evaluate where generative AI offers a better path to a client solution, and apply techniques such as prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, and model fine-tuning where appropriate

• Collaborate with technology leaders to develop and advocate for cutting-edge data science concepts to both technical audiences and business stakeholders

• Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data pipelines and platforms support modeling, experimentation, and analytics use cases

• Support data transformations at scale, including cleaning, enriching, de-duping, joining, and correlating structured, semi-structured, or unstructured data for modeling and analysis

• Define and implement new and innovative modeling techniques, experimentation strategies, and analytics workflows within Bain's full model development life cycle, including documentation, unit/integration testing, and reviews

• Support model deployment and operationalization in collaboration with engineering teams, ensuring scalable data science solutions

• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders; lead working sessions, present recommendations, and write crisp technical documentation

• Collaborate with client data engineering and analytics teams and, when needed, contribute to data acquisition, extraction, and preparation to ensure data is fit for modeling and analysis

• Establish and promote best practices for model development, documentation, and reuse, enabling scalable and repeatable approaches across industries and use cases

• Help prioritize and scope data science initiatives by translating complex client business problems into actionable projects with clear execution paths

• Provide technical guidance to external clients and internal stakeholders at Bain

• Contribute to industry-leading innovations that translate into meaningful impact for clients in casework

• Stay current with emerging trends and technologies in data science, and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the capabilities of the analytics platform

ABOUT YOU

Required:

• A strong generalist background with proficiency across core data science methods, including forecasting, statistical modeling, optimization modeling and machine learning

• An interest in applying your expertise across a wide array of industries and problems

• Strong experience working in common data science query and programming languages (Python required, at least working knowledge of SQL)

• Hands-on experience with at least two of the following problem types, with breadth of experience across associated tools and techniques

• Marketing mix modeling (Bayesian regression, causal inference, adstock/saturation modeling)

• Price elasticity and optimization (econometrics, causal inference, optimization)

• Segmentation and personalization (clustering, recommendation systems, experimentation, bandits)

• Supply chain / OR (optimization, simulation)

• Demand forecasting (time series, hierarchical forecasting, ML)

• Predictive maintenance (survival analysis, anomaly detection, sensor time series)

• Experience building and evaluating LLM-based applications, including prompt optimization

• Experience in AI-native delivery, such as using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate modeling work, generate and test hypotheses, and prototype analytical approaches

• Hands-on experience collaborating with engineering teams to take models into production

• Experience working in agile, cross-functional team environments

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, including the ability to discuss technicalities of solutions, algorithms, and techniques with colleagues and clients

• Curiosity, proactivity, and critical thinking

• Ability to collaborate with people at all levels and with multi-office/region teams

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with both internal leadership and with clients

• Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and complexity, manage priorities, and deliver outcomes independently or with a collaborative team

• Advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Econometrics, Statistics or Information Sciences

• 3+ years of experience in advanced analytics or related field

Preferred (non-requisite)

• Working knowledge of Bayesian methods

• Experience deploying ML models using containerization (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform) and MLOps tooling such as MLflow and GitHub Actions

• Experience managing data workflows and pipelines for modeling

• Working knowledge of SQL or NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Snowflake, or similar)

• Experience scaling model training and inference on large datasets, and optimizing pipelines for performance in production environments

• Experience with building complete web apps using coding assistants

• Experience building agentic harnesses and orchestration of agentic processes

• PhD is a plus

This role requires a minimum of three days per week working together in person, either at a client location or at your Bain home office.

Travel is required beyond your home office / primary working location. Frequency and destination vary by project needs.

U.S. COMPENSATION INFORMATION

Compensation for this role includes base salary, annual discretionary performance bonus, 401(k) plan with an annual employer contribution based on years of service and Bain’s best in class benefits package (details listed below).

Now is a great time to join Redhorse Corporation. We are a solution-driven company delivering data insights and technology solutions to customers with missions critical to U.S. national interests. We’re looking for thoughtful, skilled professionals who thrive as trusted partners building technology-agnostic solutions and want to apply their talents supporting customers with difficult and important mission sets.

Redhorse transforms the way government uses data and technology. To support this mission, we are seeking an executive-level Data Scientist Subject Matter Expert (SME) to provide high-impact advisory and technical services to the National Security Branch (NSB) and senior executive priority programs.

In this role, you will serve as the principal technical authority designing advanced machine learning architectures, novel algorithms, and exploratory data pipelines across high-stakes law enforcement, intelligence, and investigative datasets. You will partner directly with senior government stakeholders to turn massive, disparate data environments into decisive operational advantages, delivering high-level briefings, interactive data visualizations, and robust analytical solutions.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and design machine learning, statistical analysis, and complex data science projects across multiple workstreams.

• Collaborate directly with internal and external government stakeholders to diagnose system workflows and implement high-impact modernization strategies.

• Architect innovative methodologies to ingest, analyze, and exploit large volumes of law enforcement, intelligence, investigative, and business data.

• Develop custom mathematical models, data structures, algorithms, and specialized software code to optimize enterprise search and data discovery.

• Utilize programming languages such as Python to build production-ready scripts for automated data collection, cleaning, and processing.

• Design, test, and validate data quality frameworks and automated verification pipelines to ensure analytical integrity.

• Coordinate across multi-disciplinary engineering and functional teams to deploy predictive models and evaluate operational impact.

• Analyze multi-source data outputs and deliver clear, actionable recommendations to senior agency leadership.

• Develop intuitive data visualizations, infographics, dashboards, and executive summaries to communicate technical findings to non-technical leaders.

• 10 years of experience as a Data Scientist, Data Engineer, or Developer acting as a technical development lead for collecting, cleaning, and analyzing massive datasets to build predictive models.

• 10 years of experience in software development and programming across multiple languages, statistical packages, dataset manipulation tools, and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) frameworks.

• 8 years of experience utilizing data systems to acquire, extract, and structure data for research, exploration, and statistical analysis.

• 8 years of experience analyzing, interpreting, and discovering patterns in complex datasets using exploratory data analysis techniques.

• 8 years of experience cleaning, manipulating, munging, and sub-setting large-scale structured and unstructured data.

• 8 years of experience communicating technical findings, risk assessments, and analytical results to non-technical audiences using summary visualizations and tables.

• Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn emerging technologies and operate effectively both independently and in mission-critical team environments.

• Active Top Secret/SCI with CI Poly.

We encourage all candidates who meet the basic requirements to apply, even if you do not have any of the following experience:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from an accredited college or university in Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, Physical Science, or a related quantitative discipline.

• 8 years of experience applying cutting-edge data mining, machine learning, and predictive analytics techniques to correlate disparate events and multi-source datasets.

• Natural Language Processing (NLP) expertise, including large-scale document mining and parsing unstructured textual data into structured databases.

• Product-agnostic database and enterprise search administration for large-scale data exploitation.

Overview:

The Housing Center at the American Enterprise Institute (AEI) is the nation’s leading market-oriented housing research center. It operates at the intersection of data-driven housing knowledge and policy solutions.

The AEI Housing Center seeks a full-time, in-person (senior) data scientist to develop and manage large datasets to derive insights and inform US housing policy. The data scientist will be responsible for maintaining the nation’s foremost housing database and designing the systems and infrastructure that produce research to improve the operation of housing markets, mortgage lending practices, and housing policy. This will include seeking, creating, cleaning, and analyzing new datasets; developing automated processes for data maintenance; and building the infrastructure for regular Housing Center updates on the housing market.

This position requires superior technical and quantitative skills, the capacity to develop additional skills, and the initiative to build new systems and processes. The ideal candidate will have a demonstrated interest in and knowledge of housing policy. Creativity, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple complex projects and deliver reliable results are essential. The anticipated start date for this position is as soon as possible.

Final title and salary will be commensurate with a candidate’s educational level and years of full-time, applicable work experience. Master’s degree preferred. Candidates who can successfully meet the responsibilities of this role are encouraged to apply, regardless of their years of experience. AEI offers a stimulating and harmonious work environment and excellent benefits. Applicants must submit a cover letter demonstrating their interest in housing policy and noting their quantitative and technical experience and skills, a resume, an unofficial academic transcript, and a writing sample with the online application. Candidates also will be asked to pass a skills assessment and an analytical assessment.

To maintain transparency and integrity in the interview process, candidates must disclose any use of AI, the tool they used, and explain how it was utilized.

• Develop models, algorithms, and metrics to facilitate data interpretation and work with team members to present and operationalize data for analysis.
• Automate recurring analyses that are currently performed manually, including data collection, cleaning, reporting, and visualization.
• Lead data projects from source acquisition through technical design, quality control, publication, and ongoing maintenance.
• Translate technical findings by creating interactive dashboards and data visualizations that make Housing Center data and insights accessible to researchers and the public.
• Examine data for trends and anomalies to draw actionable conclusions; present findings and recommendations to the team.
• Use APIs, web scraping, and other computational methods to collect new data.
• Experiment with emerging methods for gathering and processing data, including AI-assisted analysis.

• Conduct advanced predictive modeling, statistical analyses, and machine learning on complex datasets.
• Establish and advise on best practices for data management, emerging methodologies, and analysis, improving the center’s analytical capabilities.

About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will carry analytical questions for a federal agency from the data to a defensible, documented answer. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.
